notes: Official X50 Pro 5G Play / player-edition kernel source.
Only master branch was returned by the branches API.
Official Android 17 GKI release tag dated 2026-11-05.
This is a reference kernel baseline, not a device-ready RMX2072 kernel.
Snapshot commit cfa72fb3d7f89372c7e449a4de2477551ea4c29c maps to this upstream commit; the mirror is source-only and intentionally omits upstream Git history.
The official Android kernel manifest, Kleaf, Clang, Rust toolchain and Bazel dependencies remain synced from their pinned upstream repositories.
